rawContent: @mikkipedia @_noujoum @TaranaBurke Well, but they ARE brought down by the #metoo movement. If they were brought down by their actions, it would have happened earlier and instantly. I get your issue with "victimizing" the rapists, but in this case isn't it more of a "triumph of the victims over their oppressors"?

@mikkipedia @_noujoum @TaranaBurke I mean, one of my core issues here is that rapists can rape and still thrive in society, while their victims cry silently every day. And the silence of the victims is sth. the #metoo movement tries to overcome. This is what brings down those assholes. It's an achievement.
